prokeimenon.text: Deliver me from my enemies, O my God, and protect me from those who rise up against me.
prokeimenon.verse: Deliver me from those who work iniquity.

paremias.title: The Suffering Servant of the Lord

epistle_prokeimenon.text: The rulers took counsel together against the Lord and against His Anointed.
epistle_prokeimenon.verse: Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?

epistle.incipit: Brethren: I received from the Lord that which I also delivered to you: that the Lord Jesus, on the same night in which He was betrayed, took bread...

verses: Blessed is he that considers the poor and needy; the Lord will deliver him in the evil day.

gospel.title: The Mystical Supper and the Betrayal
gospel.incipit: The Lord said to His disciples: You know that after two days is the Feast of the Passover, and the Son of Man will be delivered up to be crucified...

holy_thursday.zadostoinyk: Come, O faithful, let us enjoy the Master's hospitality and the table of immortality in the upper room...

epistle_prokeimenon.text: Let all the earth worship You and sing praise to You; let it sing praise to Your name, O Most High.
epistle_prokeimenon.verse: Shout with joy to God, all the earth.

epistle.incipit: Brethren: As many of us as were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into His death...

alleluia_replace.text: Instead of the Alleluia, we sing in Tone VII: 'Arise, O God, judge the earth, for You shall inherit all nations.'
verses: God stands in the congregation of the mighty; He judges among the gods.
How long will you judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked?
Defend the poor and fatherless; do justice to the afflicted and needy.
Deliver the poor and needy; rid them out of the hand of the wicked.
They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness; all the foundations of the earth are shaken.
I have said, You are gods, and all of you are children of the Most High.
But you shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.
alleluia_replace.rubric: While this hymn is sung, the clergy change from dark lenten vestments into bright white vestments.

gospel.incipit: Now after the Sabbath, as the first day of the week began to dawn, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb...

holy_saturday.trisagion_replace: All you who have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ. Alleluia.
holy_saturday.cherubic_hymn_replace: Let all mortal flesh keep silent, and stand with fear and trembling, and ponder nothing earthly within itself...
holy_saturday.zadostoinyk: Do not weep for Me, O Mother, beholding in the tomb the Son Whom you conceived in your womb without seed...
holy_saturday.koinonikon: The Lord awoke as from sleep, and has risen to save us. Alleluia.

epistle_prokeimenon.text: The Lord said to Me: You are My Son; today I have begotten You.
epistle_prokeimenon.verse: Ask of Me, and I will give You the nations for Your inheritance.

epistle.incipit: God, Who at sundry times and in divers manners spoke in time past unto the fathers by the prophets, has in these last days spoken unto us by His Son...

verses: The Lord said to my Lord: Sit at My right hand, until I make Your enemies Your footstool.
The Lord shall send the rod of Your power out of Zion.

gospel.incipit: And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Caesar Augustus, that all the world should be enrolled...

epistle_prokeimenon.text: The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear?
epistle_prokeimenon.verse: The Lord is the defense of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

epistle.incipit: Brethren: Though I am free from all men, I have made myself a servant to all, that I might win the more...

verses: My heart overflows with a good theme; I address my verses to the King.
You are fairer than the children of men; grace is poured upon Your lips.
